economics.name: Initial implementation effort
economics.description: Effort to establish controlled production environments, model and first use case.

economics.name: Service stitching and integration burden
economics.description: Complexity of services, identities, connectors, policies, metadata and hand-offs.

economics.name: Time to first production outcome
economics.description: Elapsed time and iteration to a controlled production outcome, not a prototype.

economics.name: Custom code and configuration volume
economics.description: Custom application, pipeline, integration, policy, infrastructure, monitoring and test code/configuration.

economics.id: Security, governance and audit engineering effort
economics.name: Security, governance and audit engineering effort
economics.description: Custom engineering for authorization, lineage, audit, retention and compliance.

economics.id: Ongoing code maintenance and regression burden
economics.name: Ongoing code maintenance and regression burden
economics.description: Maintenance, dependencies, refactoring, tests and cross-service regression.

economics.name: Ongoing platform engineering and operations
economics.description: Recurring SRE/platform monitoring, incident, capacity, backup and environment work.

economics.name: Change and iteration economics
economics.description: Cost and cycle time for new sources, objects, workflows, applications, models and agents.

economics.name: Upgrade and cross-service regression burden
economics.description: Coordination and testing as products, APIs and runtimes change.

economics.name: Consumption and cost predictability
economics.description: Forecasting, attribution, constraint and optimization of consumption.

economics.name: Specialist skills and services dependency
economics.description: Dependence on scarce skills, integrators, vendor services or specialist teams.

economics.name: Exit and migration economics
economics.description: Cost to export and migrate data, logic, applications, controls and history.

domain.name: Priority use-case fit
domain.description: Direct fit to the buyer’s named use cases, decisions, users and operating cadence.

domain.name: Industry/domain data-model maturity
domain.description: Availability and maturity of relevant object models, semantics and domain relationships.

domain.name: Domain applications and reusable patterns
domain.description: Relevant packaged applications, templates, workflows, accelerators and implementation patterns.

domain.name: Comparable production references
domain.description: Evidence from deployments comparable in industry, scope, scale, controls and workflow.

domain.name: Operational workflow and decision-cadence fit
domain.description: Fit to the human and automated decisions, latency and workflow required by the scenario.

domain.name: Domain-specific data and relationship support
domain.description: Support for the scenario’s documents, events, geospatial, graph, telemetry, transactions or multimodal data.

domain.name: Domain regulatory and security fit
domain.description: Fit to industry-specific policy, records, explainability, validation and regulatory obligations.

domain.name: Real-time and event requirement fit
domain.description: Ability to meet the scenario’s event, streaming and freshness requirements.

domain.name: Analytics simulation and optimization fit
domain.description: Fit to required forecasting, optimization, simulation, graph analytics or decision intelligence.

domain.name: Extension beyond initial use case
domain.description: Ability to reuse the implementation for adjacent use cases without rebuilding core semantics and controls.

adoption.name: Measurable business-outcome alignment
adoption.description: Clear connection between platform use, operational behavior and measurable outcomes.

adoption.name: End-user usability and workflow fit
adoption.description: Fit to user roles, tasks, decision context and existing or redesigned workflows.

adoption.name: Time to user competency
adoption.description: Time and effort for target users, administrators and builders to become effective.

adoption.name: Product management and ownership model
adoption.description: Support for durable business ownership, backlog, release and outcome management.

adoption.name: Process-change feasibility
adoption.description: Practicality of required process, role, control and accountability changes.

adoption.name: Human-in-the-loop accountability
adoption.description: Support for approvals, review, override, explanation and accountable decisions.

adoption.name: Adoption and outcome measurement
adoption.description: Ability to instrument usage, behavior, operational KPIs and outcome attribution.

adoption.id: Reuse across teams and use cases
adoption.name: Reuse across teams and use cases
adoption.description: Ability to reuse semantics, components, policies and delivery patterns across teams.

adoption.name: Business-user configurability
adoption.description: Ability for authorized business users to configure views, workflows and rules without unsafe changes.

adoption.name: Training and enablement requirement
adoption.description: Favorability of training, enablement and support requirements.

adoption.name: Accessibility and localization
adoption.description: Support for accessibility, languages and regional user requirements.

adoption.name: Legacy process and tool retirement
adoption.description: Ability to retire fragmented tools, reports and manual process steps.

adoption.name: Benefit durability and continuous improvement
adoption.description: Ability to sustain benefits through feedback, measurement and iterative improvement.

career.name: Labour-market demand
career.description: Share of job postings that name the skill, relative to peers.

career.name: Pay premium
career.description: Salary premium over a baseline data or engineering role.

career.name: Skill longevity and vendor trajectory
career.description: Likelihood the skill is still valued in 3-5 years: vendor health, momentum, standards.

career.name: Skill transferability
career.description: How far the skill carries to other tools: open standards, SQL/Python, portable concepts.

career.name: Learning resources and certification
career.description: Official courses, certifications, documentation and third-party training.

career.name: Community size and activity
career.description: User groups, forums, conferences, Q&A volume.

career.name: Open-source engagement
career.description: Open-source core or ecosystem a practitioner can contribute to and learn from.

career.name: Hands-on access
career.description: Free tier, trial, community edition or local install for self-learning.

validationPlan.Required measurement/evidence: Data/control plane, failure domains, tenancy, data movement, external dependencies, egress and operating ownership
p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput at target concurrency and data volume
1-hop and 3–6-hop tests over low-, medium- and high-degree vertices; cross-partition fan-out
Recall@k, p95/p99 latency, index build/update time and cost at required vector count
Vector + text + graph + structured filters at 1%, 10% and 50% selectivity; leakage tests
Objects, edges, events and embeddings per second; update-to-query visibility and backfill behavior
Node/zone/control-plane failures during reads and writes; measured RPO/RTO and restored-index consistency
Object, field, relationship/path and action tests for human, service and agent identities
Hidden-node counts, forbidden paths, ANN ranking influence, caches, logs, prompts and derived-property leakage
Source value → transformation → ontology object → retrieval → recommendation → approval → external action
Breaking schema/ontology/model/prompt change, compatibility check, staged promotion and rollback
Least privilege, typed validation, approval, idempotency, timeout, retry, compensation and kill switch
Groundedness, task success, policy violations, unsafe action rate, latency, cost and regression tests
Bulk export of schema/ontology, objects, links, vectors, history, policies, lineage, audit and application artifacts
License/consumption, infrastructure, integration, support, staffing, egress and migration/exit costs
Inventory products/services, interfaces, identity boundaries, control implementations, delivery roles, iterations, elapsed time and one-time cost.
Annual license, cloud consumption, support, SRE/platform/data/security FTE, incident, upgrade, regression and enhancement capacity.
3- and 5-year cash and discounted TCO; workload growth, staffing, price, utilization, implementation delay and contingency sensitivity.
Measured cost and cycle time to add a source, object type, pipeline, governed application, model and agent action.
Execute representative end-to-end workflows with target users, data, decision cadence, domain controls and outcome measures.
Reference similarity by industry, workflow, data, scale, controls, deployment, delivery duration and achieved outcomes.
Task completion, time to competency, usability, exception handling, approval accountability and role-change effort.
Baseline KPI, target, attribution method, owner, measurement cadence, ramp, confidence and benefit sensitivity.
Dependency register, unproven interfaces, critical path, reference-class estimate, P50/P90 schedule and cost ranges.
Proprietary artifacts, cloud/vendor/partner dependencies, export completeness, contractual exposure, skills market and tested exit plan.
Source access, quality, IAM, semantic ownership, process, product ownership, controls capacity, skills, AI governance and change capacity.
Elapsed time to a controlled production workflow including data, controls, application/agent, testing and release.
Inventory application, pipeline, integration, policy, infrastructure, monitoring and test code/configuration and ownership.
Annual effort for dependencies, upgrades, tests, incidents, policy changes and compatibility.

criteria.name: Business product ownership

criteria.name: Security and compliance delivery capacity
criteria.description: Capacity to review, approve, evidence and operate required controls.

criteria.name: Platform and engineering skills
criteria.description: Available data, application, cloud, graph, ML, SRE and integration skills.

criteria.name: AI governance readiness

criteria.name: Change-management capacity
